notes: M1.3 proof. The opening Maple Leaf Rag motif is isolated on a source-derived track; the ragtime accompaniment is deliberately not copied. ViceBlood adds a relaxed 96 BPM G-funk pocket, funk bass, electric-piano/clav comping, an original mono-lead call/response guide and low cruise pad. General MIDI sounds are placeholders; no third-party audio is embedded or required.
